title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 83 (Rwai Shad Suk Mynsiem Vol. 12)
khasi_title: Rwai Shad Suk Mynsiem Ba-paka No. 83
cultural_context: Celebrates the spring thanksgiving dance of peace and joyful hearts. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
To thiah suk ko khunlung ba jem,
Ka kmie ka ieng ban synran;
Ki angel ka bneng kin da ia pha,
Haduh ban da kynjat ka sngi ba shai.
lyrics_english:
Sleep peacefully, gentle child of my heart,
Thy mother stands watchful beside thy cradle;
The celestial guardians shall watch over thee,
Until the golden rays of dawn awaken the hills.
